# Cranes Consulting

> Cranes Consulting teaches subcontractors and small businesses in Tampa Bay and Naples, Florida to use AI to cut office time. Most trade contractors are in the field doing the work with no one in the office to handle change orders, pay applications, invoices, insurance certificates and follow-ups. We teach the owner, or whoever helps with the books, to get that paperwork done in a fraction of the time. Founder Tyler Alexander and his brother Collin Alexander co-own Alexander² Construction, a general contractor building in Tampa and Naples; Collin holds its Florida Certified Building Contractor license (CBC1266523) and co-teaches the training. Tyler is a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and PMP.

## Services

- [Money Audit](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#money-audit): one recent job, every invoice, change order, pay app and payment tied to the bank. Fixed fee, quoted after a free 30-minute call.
- [AI Office Training](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#back-office): hands-on training on the client's real jobs for change orders, pay apps, invoices, insurance requests and follow-ups. Fixed fee $10K to $25K.
- [Software Adoption](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#software-adoption), [Margin Recovery](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#margin-recovery), [Fractional PMO](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#fractional-pmo), [Grant and Rebuild Programs](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/services/#grant-programs).

## Free resources

- [GC-Approved Paperwork Pack](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/paperwork-pack/): ten copy-and-paste AI prompts for change orders, pay apps, insurance certificates, delay notices and GC replies.
- [Money Leak Calculator](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/money-leak-calculator/): estimate unpaid change order work and paperwork hours per year.
- [Workshops](https://cranesconsultingfl.com/workshops/): free Get Paid Faster workshops for trade associations, supply houses, chambers and GCs.
